phases.name: Phase 2: Chain-root, qualified-type and field-path receiver disposition
phases.description: Implementation phase, RE-GROUNDED after Phase 1 discovery and the 2026-08-01 clean re-populate. Three findings reshaped it. (1) The original premise was measured against a polluted scan: dist-preXR contributed 3,049 of 4,753 unresolved edges, and because unresolved_src_count is computed as NOT-testOrigin with no build-output exclusion at all, the "stratified honest" metric carried 3,049 of its 3,862 from build output. SCOPE-001 / TKT-HZF70M closed that; resolved_of_resolvable recovered 54.62 -> 74.83. (2) The true target is 547 edges, not 10,691 or 5,050 or 2,137. (3) About 85% of that population can never be a project edge - z.string() is zod, ts.Node is the TypeScript compiler API. The work is therefore DISPOSITION first (moving edges out of the unresolved denominator into honest external/builtin) and RESOLUTION second, and acceptance is written that way. Framing this as "resolve N edges" guarantees a false failure verdict no matter how good the code is.

Commit through the guarded runner with explicit --paths. Peer-modified files stay out.
Hard stop: final approval. Report stratified per AC-5 and name the tree fingerprint. Quoting the raw headline alone overstates the production blind spot by roughly 19x.

acceptance_criteria: AC-1 (disposition): unresolved_src_count falls, and every edge that leaves it is accounted for as external, builtin, or resolved. No edge may simply disappear.

AC-2 (no fabrication): the change adds ZERO resolved edges arising from resolver behaviour. Any valid_edge_count increase must be attributable, edge by edge, to new call sites introduced by the change itself.

AC-3 (test_dsl held): test_dsl_count does not fall. The chain root of expect(x) is a vitest import and applyTestDslReclassify fires only on unresolved results, so an ungated widening silently moves about 6.5k edges out of test_dsl with the suite still green.
AC-4 (refusal bias): receivers whose root is not provable (ternary, nullish-coalesce, second bare identifier) stay unresolved. Guessing a root to book a metric win is a defect.
AC-5 (reporting): report stratified - unresolved_src_count and resolved_of_resolvable alongside raw totals (REC-R2), and state the tree fingerprint the run was measured on.
AC-6 (attribution): the before/after pair must be measured on the SAME tree. A number measured across a peer edit or a build-tree rename is not evidence.
